55:68.text: will be fruits, and date-palms and pomegranates.

55:69.text: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both

55:71.text: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both

55:73.text: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both

55:74.text: With whom no man or jinni has had tamth

55:75.text: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both

55:76.text: Reclining on green cushions and rich beautiful mattresses.

55:77.text: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both

55:78.text: Blessed be the Name of your Lord
, the Owner of Majesty and Honour.

56:2.text: And there can be no denial of its befalling.

56:4.text: When the earth will be shaken with a terrible shake.

56:5.text: And the mountains will be powdered to dust,

56:6.text: So that they will become floating dust particles.

56:8.text: So those on the Right Hand
(i.e. those who will be given their Records in their right hands)
will be those on the Right Hand!
(As a respect for them, because they will enter Paradise)

56:9.text: And those on the Left Hand
(i.e. those who will be given their Record in their left hands)
will be those on the Left Hand!
(As a disgrace for them, because they will enter Hell)

56:10.text: [(in Islâmic Faith of Monotheism and in performing righteous deeds) in the life of this world on the very first call for to embrace Islâm]

56:13.text: will be from the first generations

56:14.text: will be from the later generations.

56:15.text: on thrones woven with gold and precious stones.
